title: China-to-Singapore Power Tool Compliance Gap Matrix
provenance: AI-compiled, multi-model cross-checked, not human-verified. Informational only; confirm with the official regulator and a qualified professional. Not legal/certification/customs/market-access advice.

rows.requirement: Electrical Safety and SAFETY Mark Scope
rows.target_requirement: Singapore operates on a 230 V, 50 Hz single-phase grid, the same 50 Hz frequency as China but a different nominal voltage from China's 220/380 V. Electrical safety for in-scope household power tools is enforced through the Consumer Protection (Safety Requirements) Registration Scheme administered by Enterprise Singapore, which requires a SAFETY Mark for Controlled Goods obtained via a Singapore-based Registered Supplier. The accepted safety basis is the SS/IEC 62841 series for hand-held, transportable, and lawn and garden tools, with the charger or external power supply assessed against the relevant safety standard.
target_standards: Consumer Protection (Safety Requirements) Registration Scheme — SAFETY Mark for Controlled Goods, administered by Enterprise Singapore
SS/IEC 62841 series for hand-held, transportable, and lawn and garden power tools
Relevant SS or IEC charger and power-supply safety standards where the tool ships with a charger or external PSU
rows.china_equivalent: China power-tool files commonly rely on the GB/T 3883 series as the safety baseline, with CCC certification where the product type is in the China compulsory product list and separate charger standards where applicable. GB/T 3883 evidence should be mapped to Singapore safety expectations rather than treated as automatic SAFETY Mark eligibility.
china_standards: GB/T 3883 series (China baseline for power-tool safety)
CCC certification where the product type is listed for compulsory certification
China charger safety standards where applicable
rows.gap: The common gap is assuming the China safety report and nominal 220 V design transfer directly. A household tool in scope of the Controlled Goods list needs SAFETY Mark registration through a Singapore-based Registered Supplier, evidence aligned to SS/IEC 62841, and confirmation that the charger or PSU suits 230 V 50 Hz mains.

target.en: Mandatory for a household power tool that falls within the Controlled Goods list: SAFETY Mark registration under the Consumer Protection (Safety Requirements) Registration Scheme via a Singapore-based Registered Supplier. Industrial tools generally fall outside the controlled-goods list and are not subject to the SAFETY Mark, although general product-safety duties still apply. SS/IEC 62841 is the commonly accepted safety standard route.
target.zh: 对于属于受控产品清单内的家用电动工具为强制：须通过新加坡本地注册供应商在《消费者保护（安全要求）注册计划》下完成 SAFETY Mark 注册。工业工具一般不在受控产品清单内，不受 SAFETY Mark 约束，但一般产品安全义务仍然适用。SS/IEC 62841 是常用的安全标准路径。
target.zht: 對於屬於受控產品清單內的家用電動工具為強制：須透過新加坡本地註冊供應商在《消費者保護（安全要求）註冊計劃》下完成 SAFETY Mark 註冊。工業工具一般不在受控產品清單內，不受 SAFETY Mark 約束，但一般產品安全義務仍然適用。SS/IEC 62841 是常用的安全標準路徑。

cn.en: China domestic baseline commonly uses GB/T 3883 series, with CCC where the product type is listed.
cn.zh: 中国境内基线通常采用 GB/T 3883 系列，产品类型在目录内时加 CCC。
cn.zht: 中國境內基線通常採用 GB/T 3883 系列，產品類型在目錄內時加 CCC。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Conditionally non-compliant for an in-scope household tool until SAFETY Mark registration is held through a Singapore-based Registered Supplier with safety evidence aligned to SS/IEC 62841 and a charger or PSU suited to 230 V 50 Hz. Industrial tools are generally outside the controlled-goods list but still carry general product-safety duties.

rows.target_requirement: Motor-driven power tools, electronic speed controllers, chargers, and power supplies should not generate excessive electromagnetic disturbance and should have adequate immunity. Where a cordless tool includes a radio function such as Bluetooth or a wireless link, the radio module must be registered with the Infocomm Media Development Authority under the IMDA equipment registration framework, which references IEC and SS EMC and radio standards. EMC for the safety-controlled tool is addressed within the SAFETY Mark technical file where the tool is in scope.
target_standards: IMDA equipment registration framework for radio-communications and short-range devices (cordless tools with a radio function)
Relevant IEC and SS EMC standards referenced for in-scope apparatus
EMC evidence within the SAFETY Mark technical file where the tool is a Controlled Good
rows.china_equivalent: China compliance packages may include EMC reports alongside GB/T 3883 safety reports, and radio modules may carry an SRRC type approval. Test limits, worst-case operating modes, charger inclusion, and any radio module still need Singapore-specific review for IMDA registration and EMC acceptance.
china_standards: China EMC standards and test reports where applicable
SRRC type approval for radio modules where applicable
rows.gap: A frequent gap is treating China EMC reports and SRRC radio approval as sufficient for Singapore. A radio-enabled cordless tool needs IMDA equipment registration, and EMC evidence should reflect the exact marketed configuration including the charger, battery pack, and controller variants.

target.en: Mandatory for cordless tools with a radio function: IMDA equipment registration before supply. EMC adequacy for an in-scope safety-controlled tool is handled within the SAFETY Mark file. EMC for a non-controlled industrial tool relies on general product-safety and non-interference duties rather than a standalone marking.
target.zh: 对于具备无线电功能的无绳工具为强制：供货前须完成 IMDA 设备注册。范围内安全受控工具的电磁兼容充分性在 SAFETY Mark 文件中处理。非受控工业工具的电磁兼容依赖一般产品安全和不干扰义务，而非独立标识。
target.zht: 對於具備無線電功能的無繩工具為強制：供貨前須完成 IMDA 設備註冊。範圍內安全受控工具的電磁相容充分性在 SAFETY Mark 文件中處理。非受控工業工具的電磁相容依賴一般產品安全和不干擾義務，而非獨立標識。

cn.en: China domestic files may include EMC evidence and SRRC radio approval, but Singapore acceptance depends on IMDA registration and configuration mapping.
cn.zh: 中国境内文件可包含 EMC 证据和 SRRC 无线电核准，但新加坡接受性取决于 IMDA 注册和配置映射。
cn.zht: 中國境內文件可包含 EMC 證據和 SRRC 無線電核准，但新加坡接受性取決於 IMDA 註冊和配置映射。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not Singapore-ready for a radio-enabled cordless tool until the radio module is registered under the IMDA equipment registration framework and EMC evidence covers the actual marketed tool system; China EMC reports and SRRC approval do not by themselves satisfy IMDA registration.

rows.requirement: Market Access and Controlled Goods Scope
rows.target_requirement: Singapore market access for a power tool turns on whether the item is a Controlled Good under the Consumer Protection (Safety Requirements) Registration Scheme administered by Enterprise Singapore. Household-type tools that fall within the controlled-goods list must be registered for a SAFETY Mark, and registration must be held by a Singapore-based Registered Supplier who is the responsible economic operator. Industrial tools generally fall outside the controlled-goods list and do not need a SAFETY Mark, but remain subject to general consumer-protection and product-safety duties.
target_standards: Consumer Protection (Safety Requirements) Registration Scheme administered by Enterprise Singapore
SAFETY Mark for Controlled Goods, held by a Singapore-based Registered Supplier
SS/IEC 62841 series [commonly accepted safety standard route]
rows.china_equivalent: China power-tool safety files commonly reference the GB/T 3883 series for hand-held motor-operated electric tools, transportable tools, and lawn and garden machinery, with CCC certification where the product type is listed. GB/T 3883 evidence does not replace SAFETY Mark registration, the Registered Supplier obligation, or Singapore market-access documentation.
china_standards: CCC certification where the product type is listed
rows.gap: A China domestic safety report is not enough for Singapore placement of an in-scope household tool. The product needs controlled-goods classification screening, SAFETY Mark registration, a Singapore-based Registered Supplier as responsible operator, and supporting safety evidence aligned to SS/IEC 62841.

target.en: Mandatory legal obligation for a household tool within the controlled-goods list: SAFETY Mark registration under the Consumer Protection (Safety Requirements) Registration Scheme, held by a Singapore-based Registered Supplier. Industrial tools are generally not Controlled Goods and are not subject to the SAFETY Mark, though general product-safety duties still apply. SS/IEC 62841 is a commonly accepted standard route, not itself a marking.
target.zh: 对于受控产品清单内的家用工具为强制法律义务：须在《消费者保护（安全要求）注册计划》下完成 SAFETY Mark 注册，由新加坡本地注册供应商持有。工业工具一般不属于受控产品，不受 SAFETY Mark 约束，但一般产品安全义务仍然适用。SS/IEC 62841 是常用的标准路径，本身不是标识。
target.zht: 對於受控產品清單內的家用工具為強制法律義務：須在《消費者保護（安全要求）註冊計劃》下完成 SAFETY Mark 註冊，由新加坡本地註冊供應商持有。工業工具一般不屬於受控產品，不受 SAFETY Mark 約束，但一般產品安全義務仍然適用。SS/IEC 62841 是常用的標準路徑，本身不是標識。

cn.en: Mandatory China domestic baseline commonly uses GB/T 3883 series for in-scope power tools, with CCC where listed.
cn.zh: 中国境内强制基线通常对适用电动工具采用 GB/T 3883 系列，目录内时加 CCC。
cn.zht: 中國境內強制基線通常對適用電動工具採用 GB/T 3883 系列，目錄內時加 CCC。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not Singapore-ready as-is for an in-scope household tool if the product file only contains GB/T 3883 evidence. Controlled-goods classification, SAFETY Mark registration, and a Singapore-based Registered Supplier are required; industrial tools are generally outside the controlled-goods list but still carry general product-safety duties.

rows.requirement: Noise Emissions and the Absence of an Outdoor-Noise Marking Regime
rows.target_requirement: Singapore does not operate an equivalent to the EU outdoor-noise marking and guaranteed sound-power scheme for equipment used outdoors, so there is no product-level noise marking or declared sound-power obligation on a power tool as a condition of supply. Noise is instead governed at the workplace and environmental level: occupational noise exposure sits under the Workplace Safety and Health framework administered by the Ministry of Manpower, and environmental and construction-site noise sits under National Environment Agency rules. These obligations attach to the user and the worksite, not to a marking on the imported tool.
target_standards: Workplace Safety and Health Act framework (occupational noise exposure), administered by the Ministry of Manpower
National Environment Agency rules on environmental and construction-site noise
No Singapore equivalent to the EU outdoor-equipment noise marking and guaranteed sound-power scheme
rows.china_equivalent: China GB/T 3883 safety evidence usually focuses on electrical and mechanical hazards, and any noise data is typically declared for information rather than as a product marking. China likewise does not require an EU-style outdoor-noise product marking, so this is a point of similarity rather than a gap on noise marking itself.
china_standards: China domestic noise declaration practice where applicable
rows.gap: There is no Singapore product-level noise-marking gap to close, because Singapore has no outdoor-noise marking regime for power tools. The real obligations are workplace noise exposure limits for the end user and worksite or environmental noise controls, which the importer should communicate rather than certify on the tool. Exporters should not assume an EU noise certificate is needed or accepted for Singapore entry.

target.en: No mandatory product-level noise marking for power tools in Singapore. Mandatory obligations exist at the workplace level (occupational noise exposure under the Workplace Safety and Health framework) and at the environmental or construction-site level (National Environment Agency rules), but these attach to users and worksites, not to a marking on the imported tool.
target.zh: 新加坡对电动工具没有强制的产品级噪声标识。强制义务存在于工作场所层面（工作场所安全与卫生框架下的职业噪声暴露）和环境或施工场地层面（国家环境局规则），但这些附着于使用者和作业场地，而非进口工具上的标识。
target.zht: 新加坡對電動工具沒有強制的產品級噪聲標識。強制義務存在於工作場所層面（工作場所安全與衛生框架下的職業噪聲暴露）和環境或施工場地層面（國家環境局規則），但這些附著於使用者和作業場地，而非進口工具上的標識。

cn.en: China likewise has no EU-style outdoor-noise product marking for power tools; noise data is typically declared for information.
cn.zh: 中国同样对电动工具没有欧盟式户外噪声产品标识；噪声数据通常作为信息声明。
cn.zht: 中國同樣對電動工具沒有歐盟式戶外噪聲產品標識；噪聲數據通常作為資訊聲明。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] No Singapore product-level noise marking applies to power tools, so an EU outdoor-noise certificate is neither required nor a route to entry. The genuine obligations are workplace noise exposure and worksite or environmental noise control, which fall on users and worksites rather than on a marking on the imported tool.

rows.target_requirement: Singapore does not impose an EU-style RoHS marking as a condition of placing a power tool on the market, so there is no standalone RoHS declaration obligation equivalent to the EU regime. Instead, end-of-life and hazardous-material handling is addressed through the National Environment Agency Extended Producer Responsibility scheme for regulated electrical and electronic equipment, which places collection and reporting duties on producers, and through hazardous-substance controls for specific chemicals. Exporters should screen whether their tool category and battery fall within the regulated e-waste product list.
target_standards: National Environment Agency Extended Producer Responsibility scheme for regulated electrical and electronic equipment (e-waste)
Hazardous-substance controls for specific chemicals where applicable
No Singapore equivalent to an EU RoHS marking as a market-access condition
rows.china_equivalent: China power-tool files may include China RoHS material declarations alongside GB/T 3883 safety evidence. China RoHS material data can support an e-waste and material review, but it does not by itself create or satisfy Singapore producer-responsibility registration or reporting duties.
china_standards: China RoHS material declarations where applicable
rows.gap: The gap is not an EU-style RoHS marking but producer-responsibility screening. If the tool category is regulated e-waste in Singapore, the responsible party may need EPR registration, take-back arrangements, and reporting. China RoHS data helps with material review but does not discharge these Singapore duties.

target.en: No mandatory EU-style RoHS marking for Singapore market access. Mandatory duties may arise under the National Environment Agency Extended Producer Responsibility scheme where the tool category is regulated e-waste, and under hazardous-substance controls for specific chemicals.
target.zh: 新加坡市场准入没有欧盟式 RoHS 强制标识。当工具类别属于受规管电子废弃物时，可能在国家环境局生产者延伸责任计划下产生强制义务，并在针对特定化学品的有害物质控制下产生义务。
target.zht: 新加坡市場准入沒有歐盟式 RoHS 強制標識。當工具類別屬於受規管電子廢棄物時，可能在國家環境局生產者延伸責任計劃下產生強制義務，並在針對特定化學品的有害物質控制下產生義務。

cn.en: China RoHS or GB/T 3883 evidence supports material review but does not satisfy Singapore producer-responsibility duties.
cn.zh: 中国 RoHS 或 GB/T 3883 证据支持材料审查，但不能满足新加坡生产者责任义务。
cn.zht: 中國 RoHS 或 GB/T 3883 證據支援材料審查，但不能滿足新加坡生產者責任義務。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] No EU-style RoHS marking gates Singapore entry, but the tool category should be screened against the National Environment Agency Extended Producer Responsibility e-waste scope and hazardous-substance controls; China RoHS data supports material review only.

rows.target_requirement: Singapore does not have a single EU-style battery regulation imposing battery passport, removability, and conformity-marking duties as a market-access condition. The lithium battery pack of a cordless tool is governed by product-safety expectations under the relevant SS or IEC battery and tool standards within any applicable SAFETY Mark file, by lithium-battery transport rules for shipment, and by National Environment Agency battery and e-waste producer-responsibility obligations at end of life. Cordless tools that contain a wireless function additionally require IMDA registration.
target_standards: Relevant SS or IEC battery and tool safety standards within any applicable SAFETY Mark file
National Environment Agency battery and e-waste producer-responsibility obligations
IMDA registration where the cordless tool has a wireless function
rows.china_equivalent: China tool files often treat the battery pack as an accessory tested with the tool under GB/T 3883, or rely on separate lithium-battery safety and transport evidence such as UN 38.3. Singapore handling is split across product safety, transport, and producer-responsibility duties rather than a single battery marking.
china_standards: China lithium battery safety and transport evidence such as UN 38.3 where applicable
rows.gap: Cordless tools need battery handling addressed across several Singapore tracks rather than one battery regulation: product safety within any SAFETY Mark file, lithium-battery transport for shipment, e-waste and battery producer-responsibility at end of life, and IMDA registration where a wireless function is present. A battery that passes China domestic or transport tests still needs this Singapore mapping.

target.en: No single mandatory EU-style battery regulation in Singapore. Mandatory obligations are distributed: product safety within any applicable SAFETY Mark file, lithium-battery transport rules for shipment, National Environment Agency battery and e-waste producer-responsibility duties, and IMDA registration for wireless-enabled cordless tools.
target.zh: 新加坡没有单一的欧盟式强制电池法规。强制义务分散：任何适用 SAFETY Mark 文件内的产品安全、出货的锂电池运输规则、国家环境局电池和电子废弃物生产者责任义务，以及具备无线功能的无绳工具的 IMDA 注册。
target.zht: 新加坡沒有單一的歐盟式強制電池法規。強制義務分散：任何適用 SAFETY Mark 文件內的產品安全、出貨的鋰電池運輸規則、國家環境局電池和電子廢棄物生產者責任義務，以及具備無線功能的無繩工具的 IMDA 註冊。

cn.en: China tool and battery evidence such as GB/T 3883 and UN 38.3 does not automatically satisfy Singapore product-safety, transport, and producer-responsibility duties.
cn.zh: 中国工具和电池证据如 GB/T 3883 和 UN 38.3 不会自动满足新加坡产品安全、运输和生产者责任义务。
cn.zht: 中國工具和電池證據如 GB/T 3883 和 UN 38.3 不會自動滿足新加坡產品安全、運輸和生產者責任義務。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not Singapore-ready for cordless tools until the battery pack is mapped across product safety within any SAFETY Mark file, lithium-battery transport, e-waste and battery producer-responsibility, and IMDA registration where wireless; there is no single EU-style battery regulation to satisfy.
